_note: Assumptions for the Jezero crater data-center site study (second region). Every value here is a scenario assumption, not data. Edit freely; then run python -m martian_map snapshot --scenario scenario/jezero.json.
name: Jezero crater data-center site study

base.note: assumption: Perseverance's landing spot (Octavia E. Butler Landing), on the crater floor east of the delta, inside a landing area NASA already judged safe. Placeholder until the team decides.

study.name: CTX DTM F05_037818_1977_XN_17N282W__F04_037330_2008_XN_20N282W
study.note: chosen 2026-11-15 from the USGS CTX DTMs covering the study area: 90% of the study area has heights (the best of four)

fine.name: HiRISE DTM DTEEC_045994_1985_046060_1985_U01
fine.note: the 1 m model that covers the landing spot; at the landing spot it agrees with Perseverance's own height within 1 m (checked 2026-11-15)

trip_area.note: assumption: 2.5 x 4.8 km box around the base and both near-base sites with a margin of about 120 m, for planning walking and rover routes (2 m elevation and slope).

sites.name: Near base, north (crater floor)
sites.note: assumption: 2 x 2 km candidate chosen 2026-11-15 by screening the 20 m CTX slope map for flat crater floor inside the 1 m model, 1-3 km from the base (near edge 0.3 km, far corner 2.7 km); 92% of 20 m cells at or under 5 degrees.

sites.name: Near base, south (crater floor, toward Perseverance's early drive)
sites.note: assumption: 2 x 2 km candidate chosen 2026-11-15 the same way (near edge 0.3 km, far corner 2.9 km); 96% of 20 m cells at or under 5 degrees.

facility_footprint_m.note: not agreed; 200 x 200 m = 4 ha, the top of the 2-4 ha precinct search envelope in docs/reference-facility.md

max_construction_slope_deg.note: overall pad tilt; proposed baseline (P) in docs/requirements/buildable-terrain.md

max_local_pad_slope_deg.note: steepest 10 m x 10 m window on the pad; proposed baseline (P) in docs/requirements/buildable-terrain.md

max_roughness_m.note: placeholder only: BT-08 has no universal limit; it must come from the support design (R_allow)

vehicle_step_limit_m.note: illustration only in docs/requirements/buildable-terrain.md; not an adopted rover capability

dem_vertical_precision_m.note: used for noise floors; the USGS elevation models state no vertical precision

reference_facility.note: copied from docs/reference-facility.md (proposals, not engineering values)
